data.name: Abdullah
data.gender_notes: Abdullah is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A theophoric compound: ʿabd, 'servant', + Allāh, 'God' — 'servant of Allah'. Its root is ع-ب-د + الله. Borne by ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib, father of the Prophet ﷺ. Abdullah is a Arabic name meaning “Servant of Allah”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Abdullah expresses “Servant of Allah”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abdullah total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
